patterns.note: A fixed-position left sidebar navigation provides persistent access to site sections, while the main content area scrolls independently.
The site heavily features custom, display-oriented typefaces for headings and product showcases, contrasted with a small, monospaced font for labels and metadata.
A stark, high-contrast palette of black and white is consistently used, with a single vibrant orange/red as the primary accent color.
The initial hero section features a dynamic, abstract orange graphic that animates and then settles into a static, textured background as the user scrolls.
A large, stylized 3D outline of 'BSMNT' is positioned as a fixed background element at the bottom of the page, gradually revealing itself as the user scrolls past the main content sections.
Each typeface product is presented in its own full-width section, featuring a large preview of the font name and minimal metadata.

technique_notes: A fixed-position left sidebar navigation is implemented, allowing the main content area to scroll independently alongside it.

The hero section utilizes a full-bleed, dynamic background (likely a video or canvas animation) that plays upon page load and then transitions into a static, textured background as the user scrolls down.
Large, stylized 3D text is used as a fixed background element at the bottom of the page, creating a sense of depth and revealing itself as the foreground content scrolls over it.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, custom display fonts for headings and typeface previews (~8-10x body) with small, monospaced uppercase labels and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with all corners and elements maintaining a strict 90-degree angle.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and a clear, structured grid for content presentation.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its brutalist, high-contrast aesthetic, driven by custom, highly stylized display typefaces and a stark black-and-orange color scheme. The dynamic hero animation and the large, fixed 3D text at the bottom create a memorable, almost industrial-art feel that elevates it beyond a typical font showcase.
